verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a government service that exposes machine APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows APIs exist: a developer portal, an api.uspto.gov endpoint that issues an auth challenge, and documented direct API calls in Patent Center. Raw APIs are only building blocks, and nothing in the pack documents an official SDK or client library, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
